ALDERMOOR GROUP IT: NETWORK SEGMENTATION PLAN (extract)
Owner: Group IT infrastructure
Start: in four months from today. Rollout plant by plant over six weeks.

Summary
- All plant OT and IoT devices move to segmented VLANs with default-deny outbound.
- Exceptions must be requested per device class with ports, destinations and an owner.

Exception register (current)
| Device class        | Plants | Ports / destinations     | Owner     | Status   |
| CCTV NVR            | all    | 443 to vendor cloud      | Security  | Approved |
| Access control      | all    | 8443 to HQ               | Facilities| Approved |
| Drone docks         | ?      | ?                        | ?         | NOT LISTED |

Known link quality issues: plants 11, 12, 13, 14 (4G backup only, frequent drops).
Note: IT was not involved in the drone dock installs.
